title: Quiet old New Orleans, its bands and the 'Kid' nicknames
summary: He names the early bands and the many 'Kids' and speculates why musicians took that name.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Tell about the first music you ever heard when you were a kid. Was it the brass band?
Oh, no, no. First music I've heard when I was a kid. Well, I'll tell you, I just can't recall that.
What kind of music did you hear usually though?
Well, I don't know. Well, did they have much noise in those days then? I feel like automobiles or what? No, they didn't all know.
Automobiles, no. Didn't happen. There wouldn't be as many buildings or other buildings? No, no, no. Everything was all open.

Yeah, I like the automobile like that now. No, you didn't like that. Everything was quiet, you see. It was wonderful, I'm telling you. It was wonderful. Now, we had some wonderful bands. I could name you some of those bands, let's see. They had the Golden Leaf Band. They had the Maple Leaf Band. They had the Supreme Band. They had the Crescent City Band. They had the Superior Band. They had the Olympic Band. They had the Eagle Band. They had the Eagle Band. All those bands. And later on they had, I recall they had all the kids like, Kid Punch, Kid Rene, Kid Tibor Remy, Kid Clayton, Chris Kelly, Kid Shots, and many, many others. They had the many, many bands.
Why did they call them Kid?

Well, I don't know where they got there. I guess it just was a fail. I mean, I don't like that it's a fail. I mean, everybody wanted to be a kid at that time. I guess they started young. So they, they're a kid.
One time I remember a lot of the prize fighters were called Kid and Jews. Yeah, Kid John. Well, they got, they got, they got a few.

Kid Gabriela. Yeah, they got a few fighters now, right now. God keeps the name of Kid. Yeah. Well, Bob, those was the days. Bob Campbell. Really was the days. I wish you could have witnessed that. So do I. Yeah, I wish you could have witnessed that.
